tools.faq.a.01: Yes. Every tool on this page is free, with no signup, no account, and no email. Files are processed in your browser and never uploaded. The price tag (only on the 'Generate' tab) covers the AI wedding video styles and is the only paid item across all 13 tools.
tools.faq.a.02: No. Open any of the 32 tools, use it, close the tab. Nothing follows you. If you opt into the AI wedding video flow, you create an account at the order step only — that account is just to deliver your video files.
tools.faq.a.03: In your browser. Photos stay on your device (we never receive them, train AI on them, or have a breach risk on our side). Seating chart and budget calculator save to your browser's local storage — clear your browser data and they're gone, so export a CSV when you have something worth keeping.
tools.faq.a.04: Three differences: (1) we focus on the wedding photo + video workflow, not the guest-list / RSVP planning tools those sites cover. (2) Every photo tool here can hand off the same photos to the AI wedding video generator each — 8 styles in 9 minutes, in 11 languages. That end-to-end flow is unique. (3) We have no ads, no affiliate funnels, and no upsell from the free tools.
tools.faq.a.05: After editing your photos with any of the 6 photo tools, you can hand them off to the AI wedding video generator. It produces 8 video styles (cinematic trailer, save-the-date, multilingual, cartoon, pet-wedding, meme, AI auto-style, vintage restoration) at. All 8 styles together =. Same photos, no editing required, ready in 9 minutes.
tools.faq.a.06: Yes. Every tool works on a phone, though the seating chart maker is much easier on a larger screen because of the drag-drop floor plan. The 6 photo editors and 3 makers are all touch-friendly.
tools.faq.a.07: The UI is available in 11 languages (English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Japanese, Russian, Arabic, Thai, Hindi, Chinese). The AI video flow adds 11-language captions on top.
tools.faq.a.08: Absolutely. All 32 free tools work standalone. Many couples use just the photo editors to prep photos for Canva, or the seating chart maker alone. The video path is a separate option, not a requirement.
